concerns.text: Task T026 implements element sets A={K,Rb,Cs}, B={Ti,Zr,Hf}, X={F,Cl,Br,I} yielding 36 candidates. This fails to cover the Plan's Phase 3 requirement to generate a library of >= 200 candidates using the expanded sets A={K,Rb,Cs,Ba,Sr}, B={Ti,Zr,Hf,Sn,Ge}, X={F,Cl,Br,I} defined in plan.md. The task explicitly acknowledges the shortfall but provides no task to implement the missing element sets required by the plan.

Task T021 describes a 'Nested CV' approach with an 'Outer Loop' and 'Inner Loop' and an '80/20 split'. The Spec (US-2) and Plan (Phase 2) require a '5-fold cross-validation grid search' (SC-001) and a 'stratified split' for a held-out test set. The task conflates these strategies without clearly mapping the 5-fold CV requirement to the implementation steps, leaving the specific 5-fold validation logic unverified in the task description.

Task T013 instructs the system to 'proceed with available data' if the combined count from MP and OQMD is < 5,000. This contradicts FR-001 and the Plan (Phase 1) which mandate a 'minimum of 5,000 entries' and require OQMD fallback until that count is reached. The task fails to cover the mandatory enforcement of the 5,000 entry threshold.

Task T021 contains a malformed text fragment: 'results/metrics.json (including test_rmse, best_params, dft_functional) (Wikidata Q[identifier] The specific value to remove/generalize: '[identifier]' Rewritten passage:, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q113230241)'. This is a copy-paste artifact from a previous editing session that obscures the task description and must be cleaned up.

Task T030 states: 'Add a boolean column is_stable_candidate ... where True if predicted_energy < eV/atom'. The threshold value is missing (placeholder 'eV/atom' instead of a number like '-0.1'). This makes the task unimplementable as written.

Task T021b references 'SC-001' success criterion but implements a remediation path that continues execution even if the threshold is not met. While this addresses the 'low confidence' edge case, the task description is slightly ambiguous on whether it fully satisfies the binary nature of SC-001 or if it requires a separate task to handle the 'fail' state if remediation also fails.
